titulo: The nephew who is building your website
hooks: Is your nephew building your website?
I asked my nephew for a website
No nephew has ever finished a website

mensajes.texto: Tommy, how's the website for the shop coming?
Design, copy, photos and putting it online
But the logo's done: your name in bold
Btw, do you know anyone who builds websites?

contenido.remate: Your business can't wait for his next midterm

captions: Everybody has a nephew, a cousin or a buddy who's "doing your website." And we all know how it goes: almost done, almost done, almost done. Meanwhile, your customers look you up on their phone and find nothing.
If your website has been "almost done" for months, you're not alone. It happens to a ton of businesses, and almost always for the same reason: nobody owns finishing it.
Cheap ends up expensive, and free sometimes never ships. Before you pay anything, see what your business website would look like built by people who do this every day.
Your nephew has midterms and a life. Your business needs a finished website that looks good on a phone and that someone actually maintains.
